judge_origin_disparity_diagnostic.purpose: the admitted checker validates judge queries and shares a model family with one judge; checker decisions could favor errors characteristic of that family. Pre-registered here, before any successor call, per the Codex ruling.
judge_origin_disparity_diagnostic.measure: in the successor canary audit, checker rejection rate by originating judge (meta-llama/Llama-3.3-70B-Instruct-Turbo vs Qwen/Qwen3.8-2.4T-A95B), over every executed checker call, with counts
judge_origin_disparity_diagnostic.blocking_rule: if the two-sided Fisher exact p-value is below 0.05 AND the absolute rejection-rate difference is at least 10 percentage points, the audit report marks the treatment-effect interpretation BLOCKED; the gate is reported either way and never halts the run
judge_origin_disparity_diagnostic.screening_baseline: at screening: 9/48 rejects on Qwen-originated queries vs 14/48 on Llama-originated (direction OPPOSITE the self-favoring concern, Fisher p ~ 0.33, not significant)
